command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== UNIT ==='
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager
RAW=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value)
VOICE=$(printf '%s' "$RAW" | grep -oE '/[^ ;{}"]*voice_final_runtime\.py' | head -n1 || true)
echo VOICE_FINAL=$VOICE
if [ -z "$VOICE" ] || [ ! -f "$VOICE" ]; then echo 'NO_EXACT_FINAL'; exit 3; fi
DIR=$(dirname "$VOICE")
echo SCRIPTS_DIR=$DIR
echo '=== RELEVANT FILES ==='
for f in voice_final_runtime.py voice_full_runtime.py voice_full_integration.py frankenstein_identity_assembly.py voice_host_live_client.py voice_host_agent.py frank_terminal.py f2wp1207_titan_mc.py f2wp1207_grid10_turn_loop.py omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice777_interrupt_loopback_probe.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py omega_runtime.py; do p="$DIR/$f"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then printf 'FILE=%s|' "$f"; sha256sum "$p" | awk '{print $1}'; else echo MISSING=$f; fi; done
echo OMEGA_FINAL_TREE_READBACK_PASS
